dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Oh, sorry about that. I'm just so excited to see you that I got carried away for a moment there.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: All in all, everything's on track at the Fontaine Research Institute. Reconstruction is now officially on the schedule as well.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: In fact, we've already begun work on some lighter projects, and we're about to start recruiting researchers again.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: We're flourishing, wouldn't you say? It's fantastic!
